VSAN is built into the VMware vSphere hypervisor and uses local server disks to create a shared storage pool that can be used by virtual machines. It provides features such as data deduplication, compression, and encryption, as well as advanced data services like RAID, erasure coding, and stretch clustering.  Overall, VSAN simplifies storage management, reduces storage costs, and improves performance by making storage a native part of the virtual infrastructure.
